name: Paiute 2015 Elko Area Expansion

values.PipelineName: Great Basin Gas Transmission Company Pipeline System
values.StartLocation: Wieland Flat Compressor Station (Ruby Pipeline interconnect)

researcher_notes: Not matched to an existing row. The sheet has the Paiute main line (P7856) and later expansions (P7857 to P7860), but no 2015 Elko lateral. EIA August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 802: '2015 Elko Area Expansion Project', Paiute Pipeline, Lateral, Completed, in service 2015, 35 mi, 22 MMcf/d added, FERC CP14-509. A Federal Register notice of application from July 2014 and a Federal Register FERC notice from February 2015 give about 35 miles of new 8-inch pipe from a new Ruby Pipeline interconnect to the Elko city gate, and 21,994 Dth/d of service. A Northern Nevada Business Weekly article from July 2015 says FERC issued the certificate on May 14 2015 and the Bureau of Land Management approved the right-of-way for 35.2 miles. EIA is one origin; the Federal Register and trade press are independent of it. Length passes the 25 km rule (35 mi, about 56 km). Capacity is staged as 22 MMcf/d from EIA; FERC states 21,994 Dth/d. Parent staged in team style from the gazetteer hit for Southwest Gas Holdings; Paiute owner spelled per entity_style, no gazetteer entry. In-service month is October 2015 per EIA completed date; no FERC in-service notice was opened. Not checked: a pipeline route file. No route found, so RouteAccuracy is no route. Start location name Wieland Flat comes from the BLM news article; the FERC notices say only a new interconnect with Ruby.
